name: When is a character witness useful for my defense?

mainEntity.name: When is a character witness useful for my defense?

acceptedAnswer.text: A character witness can testify to your good reputation, credibility, or trustworthiness, which may affect sentencing outcomes or sway a jury in your favor, especially in cases with disputed facts.nlada​
